q: Check whether each phone number is exactly ten digits.
code:

    print(phone, "->", ok)

q: Use re.search() to check whether a line contains a six-digit pin code, and print the match.
code:
import re
line = "14 Mount Road, Chennai 600002"
m = re.search(r"\d{6}", line)
if m:
    print("found:", m.group())
else:
    print("no pin code")
